2 بجّحُه It (a thing, or an affair, TA) rejoiced him; made him joyful, glad, or happy; (A, TA;) as also ↓ ابجحّحُ . (TA.) And بَجَّحْتُهُ, (inf. n. تَبْجِيعٌ, S, K,) I rejoiced him; made him joyful, &c.: (S, Mgh, K:) or, as some say, magnified him: (TA:) and ↓ بَجَحْتُهُ , aor.
بَجِحَ , I magnified it; namely, a thing. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
